description.short: A free, student-focused day of AWS learning, hands-on practice and community in Córdoba.
description.long: AWS Student Community Day UNC 2026 is a community event created by students for students. Join talks, workshops, labs and networking activities to discover cloud careers and build practical AWS skills.

whatToExpect.description: Espacios temáticos interactivos con demos en vivo, proyectos open-source y hubs tecnológicos locales.

whatToExpect.description: Rondas ágiles de reclutamiento presencial entre estudiantes y empresas.

whatToExpect.title: Talleres Certificados y Becas
whatToExpect.description: Capacitación hands-on con becas de certificación AWS y soporte académico de FAMAF.
